note: Derived from RequirementRegister.for_phase("25"): 8 requirements owned by surfaces.operations, control.policy and acceptance.engine (6 MANDATORY: ARK-REQ-0168, 0169, 0170, 0218, 0355, 0357; 2 CONDITIONAL: ARK-REQ-0356, 0395). All eight are pre-existing register entries (MS §Operations, MS §Computer Use, BP §Mandatory, VDC §Operations, D-026), not added this phase. This phase implements C-34 Operations Telemetry + Computer-Use: real hardware/runtime/storage observability, Computer-Use action authorization composed exclusively through the existing PDP/PEP (no new policy authority), permission-aware execution boundaries, Source Intelligence Export + AI Review Bundle with secret redaction, and the Command Center HTTP surface exposing all of it. It does not build any live goal-to-product pipeline, live provider/agent/worker registry, or live browser automation -- DEF-009 remains open and is explicitly not touched by this phase's scope.

claims.implementation: telemetry.observe_operations composes runtime_telemetry.observe_runtime, hardware_telemetry.observe_hardware and storage_telemetry.observe_storage into one OperationsSnapshot, re-derived on every call from live authorities: real JobStore/JobRecovery/WorkflowExecutor state (jobs_active/queued/stuck, workflows_active), real host_probe CPU/RAM/disk/network facts, real GPU/VRAM facts, real SQLite integrity/size facts. providers/agents/workers are honestly DimensionReading.not_configured (no live registry, no live agent runtime -- DEF-009, no live worker pool -- Phase 8's own design), never fabricated. Exposed live at GET /api/operations/snapshot (Package 7).
claims.evidence: integ: test_operations_telemetry.py (8 tests, composition over real collaborators), test_operations_runtime_telemetry.py (9 tests), test_operations_hardware_telemetry.py (7 tests), test_operations_storage_telemetry.py (5 tests), test_command_operations_api.py::test_snapshot_reflects_real_host_and_database_state (real FastAPI TestClient over real SQLite/Alembic/PDP), and test_operations_journey.py's composed end-to-end proof that jobs_queued increments after a real POST /api/jobs submission made through the pre-existing Phase 7 API.
claims.note: The single register evidence key (integ) is supplied, proven against real infrastructure, not mocks.

claims.implementation: source_export.export_source walks a real file tree (excluding build/VCS directories), reads real file content, and redacts real secret shapes with the unmodified C-09 pattern (control.policy.secret_reference.redact_raw_secrets) before returning SourceFile.content -- never a second redaction rule. ai_review_bundle.build_ai_review_bundle composes architecture (observe_architecture, the live 8-gate run), tree/source (source_export), contracts (DocumentReference), issues and evidence references into one AiReviewBundle. Both are gated by the real PDP's READ_FILE decision, exactly like every other read in this context.
claims.evidence: sec: test_secret_redaction.py (6 tests: PEM keys, sk-*, ghp_*, AKIA* all redacted; non-secret content passes through unchanged) and test_operations_journey.py's own live secret-redaction step (a real OpenAI-shaped key written to a real file, exported, and proven absent from the export). integ: test_operations_source_export.py (11 tests: real tree walk, truncation, confinement, Windows-path .as_posix() correctness) and test_operations_ai_review_bundle.py (7 tests: real architecture summary, directory references with file_count, missing-reference honesty).
claims.note: Both register evidence keys (sec, integ) are supplied.

claims.implementation: Every one of the 14 canonical Computer-Use operation classes resolves through PolicyDecisionPoint.decide_computer_use -> decide_or_deny_unmapped -> the real AUTHORITY_MAP.yaml resolution matrix -- no operation class, actor, or decision is hard-coded by any Operations consumer. authorize_computer_use_action (computer_use.py) is the sole entry point process_boundary.py/file_boundary.py/browser_boundary.py and the HTTP authorize route all call; none constructs a PolicyRequest or a decision of its own. execute_process/write_workspace_file/read_workspace_file/authorize_browser_navigation all check decision.permits_execution before doing anything, and stable_mutation.prohibited_actors already names computer_use_worker, so WRITE_STABLE_FILE/ROLLBACK_STABLE resolve DENY structurally regardless of trust tier.
claims.evidence: sec: test_pdp_computer_use_decisions.py (14 tests, one per operation class, asserting the real PDP's AUTO/ASK_USER/DENY resolution matches AUTHORITY_MAP.yaml exactly) and test_operations_computer_use_adversarial.py (AST-based structural proofs: no operation-class string is hard-coded outside computer_use.py, no boundary module ever executes before checking permits_execution, WRITE_STABLE_FILE/ROLLBACK_STABLE are unreachable from computer_use_worker, no second policy authority exists). prop: test_operations_computer_use.py (property-style coverage: local_only, trust-tier, and human-gate fact plumbing all reach the real PDP unmodified).
claims.note: Both register evidence keys (sec, prop) are supplied. No new PDP/PEP/policy authority was created -- decide_computer_use is a thin, additive method on the existing PolicyDecisionPoint (Protected Core, reviewed under the stronger verification profile).

claims.implementation: runtime_telemetry.observe_runtime structurally cannot construct DimensionReading.real for providers/agents/workers: no code path in this repository calls DimensionReading.real with those three dimension names, because no live provider registry, agent runtime, or worker pool exists to observe (Phase 16/22's own acceptance records; DEF-009; Phase 8's own CAPABILITY_NOT_CONFIGURED). test_command_operations_api.py and test_operations_journey.py both submit real jobs through the real Phase 7 API and re-read the live snapshot afterward, proving providers/agents/workers stay NOT_CONFIGURED even while genuine, adjacent activity occurs -- the exact discipline that distinguishes 'honestly absent' from 'not exercised'.
claims.evidence: integ: test_no_fabricated_operational_evidence.py's AST proof (no call site anywhere in shipping source constructs DimensionReading.real for providers/agents/workers) plus its negative control (an in-memory mutated copy that does construct one is correctly rejected by the same walk, proving the check can fail). sec: the same file's second class re-runs the proof as an explicit adversarial assertion, and test_operations_journey.py's step 8 proves it end-to-end over a real running HTTP surface with real adjacent job activity, not an idle snapshot.
claims.note: Both register evidence keys (integ, sec) are supplied.

claims.implementation: Every DimensionReading in this phase's telemetry is either DimensionReading.real (backed by a genuine live read: JobStore/JobRecovery/WorkflowExecutor rows, host_probe facts, SQLite integrity_check) or DimensionReading.not_configured/not_applicable with an honest detail string naming the real absent authority -- there is no third path and no boolean substitute. Package 7's Level 3 verification read these values directly off a real running production server (scripts/run_command_center.py) against this real host: 16 logical cores, 16873545728 bytes RAM, a real NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 (8151 MiB VRAM), real disk-free bytes, 2 real network interfaces, SQLite integrity_check == 'ok', a real 163840-byte database file.
claims.evidence: integ: the same telemetry test suite cited for ARK-REQ-0168, plus test_command_operations_api.py's real-host assertions (cpu_logical_cores > 0, ram_total_bytes > 0 read from an actual TestClient response, not a fixture double). sec: test_no_fabricated_operational_evidence.py (shared proof with ARK-REQ-0218 -- the same structural guarantee that no dimension is invented is what makes 'shows real state' true rather than merely claimed).
claims.note: Both register evidence keys (integ, sec) are supplied.
